fichas.title: Natural Swimming Pool
fichas.summary: Design guidance and construction details for natural swimming pools, including spring stones, a stream, regeneration and swimming zones, water treatment, pool edges, and wooden platforms. Natural pools avoid chlorine and can have lower maintenance costs, though temporary turbidity or algae may occur. A stream can oxygenate the water as it flows over stones and cascades.
